user_message: Goal: Kiem soat ngan sach du an — phe duyet chi tieu theo nguong 500 de tranh overspend va split invoice. Actors (dung dung id, khong viet sai): ACT-REQUESTER, ACT-MANAGER, ACT-PO, ACT-FINANCE. Scope-in: submit, approve by threshold, finance post. Scope-out: payroll. Nguong 500 ap dung cho tong gia tri hoa don (invoice total), khong theo line item. ACT-FINANCE chi post so sach sau approval, khong phe duyet them.

OQ-001: Nguong 500 ap dung cho tong hoa don (invoice total). OQ-003: ACT-FINANCE chi ghi so sau approve, khong la approver cuoi. Dong tat ca OQ critical. Actors bat buoc ACT-MANAGER (khong ACT-MINAGER). Xac nhan FD du, chuyen Business Rules.
